snippet.title: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection –  Pre-order Trailer
snippet.description:
Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection pulses in on March 27, 2026 for Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Steam! 

Pre-order now to get four bonus musical arrangements as well as Geo Stelar (Casual Wear) and Omega-Xis characters for your Main Menu!

Note: Pre-order bonuses may become available through other means in the future. Check your retailer to confirm availability for the physical version.


Look forward to new upgrades and customizable features like:
- Autosaving
- Camera Panning
- Speed Boost
- Screen Layout
- Encounter Rate
- Mega Buster Power
- Damage Reduction
- HP Recovery After Battle
...and more!

Official website: https://www.capcom-games.com/megaman/starforce/en-us/
 
Discord: https://discord.gg/Capcom
